commands.command:
set -eu
cd /tmp/bloomml-m02.EonI5d/source
BASE=f780b2d4a88c2cf72c7160295d8fdea274eb0341
PATCH_SHA=9bbf2e06189fd4e43fa74106d94290ea1a1f91950cf76571e11f2430ef7890f2
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$BASE"
test "$(git diff --binary HEAD | shasum -a 256 | awk '{print $1}')" = "$PATCH_SHA"
test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)"
git diff --check
git fetch origin main
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$BASE"
python3 scripts/check_runtime_boundaries.py
python3 scripts/check_output_rf_ownership.py
python3 scripts/check_runtime_config_ssot.py
git add -A
test "$(git diff --cached --binary HEAD | shasum -a 256 | awk '{print $1}')" = "$PATCH_SHA"
git diff --cached --check
git commit -m "refactor(ipo): separate input process and output implementation ports"
CODE_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
export CODE_SHA BASE PATCH_SHA
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os
p=Path('docs/ARCHITECTURE.md')
s=p.read_text()
old='exercised by the proposed host tests; qualification remains pending until\nthe tests pass. It is not wired to Rule and does not constitute physical\nacknowledgement.'
new='exercised by passing host tests. It is not wired to Rule and does not\nconstitute physical acknowledgement.'
assert s.count(old)==1
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
p=Path('docs/CURRENT_STATUS.md')
s=p.read_text()
anchor='## Najnowszy sprint software — bez aktywacji IPO'
assert s.count(anchor)==1
p.write_text(s.replace(anchor,anchor+'\n\nM02: separacja portów I/P/O — software CLOSED_SCOPED; szczegóły i dowody w [checkpoint M02](checkpoints/2026-11-28-bloomml-m02-ipo-separation.md). Mint pozostaje konfiguracją referencyjną, fizyczna aktywacja IPO nadal zamknięta.'))
p=Path('docs/checkpoints/2026-11-28-bloomml-m02-ipo-separation.md')
assert not p.exists()
p.write_text(f"""# BloomML M02 — IPO implementation ports

Status: CLOSED_SCOPED — software separation only; not physical qualification.
Baseline: {os.environ['BASE']}
Code commit: {os.environ['CODE_SHA']}
Reviewed patch SHA-256: {os.environ['PATCH_SHA']}

## Scope
Composition binds ClimateInputSource, ClimateProcess and ClimateActuatorSink. Independent host substitution tests cover each port, execution feedback/reset, measurement status and a dual-role electrical input/output fake. Rule retains its existing usability predicate. TP357 remains the independently bound LampSafety source. OutputSupervisor retains physical output ownership. Electrical telemetry is a contract seam, not a real Shelly driver, physical ACK or thermal model. Mint bindings and closed activation remain unchanged.

## Evidence
Initial Local Agent M02-v1 failed compilation. Recovered changes were backed up; the operator applied reviewed header/test fixes locally. Operator-provided Mac logs show make test-host PASS: 53/53 main CTest suites plus 9/9 display/Clay tests; all three architecture checks PASS; ESP-IDF 5.5 CrowPanel build complete, binary 0xd1e20, 80% app partition free. Those runs preceded commit, and the audited patch was identified by SHA-256 above; firmware build metadata therefore references the baseline rather than the new commit. No new hardware evidence. Publication task verifies the exact patch hash and reruns the three architecture guards; it does not claim to have independently rerun the operator's build or tests.

H0 historical PASS, H1 PARTIAL, H2/H3 NOT ADMITTED, ClosedIpoActivationGate unchanged. No flash, serial, hardware operation, native NVS or ML/MPC activation. M03 requires separate coordinator authorization.
""")
PY
git add docs/ARCHITECTURE.md docs/CURRENT_STATUS.md docs/checkpoints/2026-11-28-bloomml-m02-ipo-separation.md
git diff --cached --check
git commit -m "docs: close M02 scoped software separation with operator evidence"
git fetch origin main
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$BASE"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git push origin HEAD:main
echo "CODE_SHA|$CODE_SHA"
echo "PUBLISHED_SHA|$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "M02_PUBLICATION_COMPLETE"
